pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Adds an additive Project Rust Character2d command family and Character2dState copied view. Motion intent is consumed inside the existing Native 2D fixed step after collider/tile synchronization and before solver integration, preserving CharacterController2D, one-way Tile Map, and deterministic fixed-step ownership without exposing engine internals across the ABI.
